acceptanceCriteria: Ship three complete recipes: understand a proposed change, prepare a change-evidence review, and verify portable proof in CI. Each declares supported inputs, prerequisites, exact invocation, expected output and completion boundary.
Each recipe includes a reproducible fixture and failure/recovery example for missing, stale or unsupported evidence, retaining uncertainty and mandatory gates instead of manufacturing a success.

Exercise all three recipes against the qualified installed release artifacts; the CI recipe uses the digest-pinned verifier from V1-0015 and requires no hosted Corvint service or LLM for proof verification.

Measure time and recovery steps to first valid receipt/review/CI verification against the current instructions with a reader unfamiliar with the recipe; report measured observations without claiming generalized savings.
State experimental versus supported paths clearly, reference the owning contracts and licensing boundaries, and keep scripts bounded with interruption cleanup for any child processes they own.
body: Owner requested all five n8n-inspired improvements as part of Corvint 0.7.0 on 2026-09-22. Original Go implementations of the patterns; no n8n source import. Extend the cited existing mechanisms. This ticket records release intent, not delivery or promotion. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Extend docs/INSTALL.md, docs/SELF-DEVELOPMENT.md and examples/cem; compose existing supported commands and ordinary scripts. Prior art: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n-docs/blob/main/docs/integrations/builtin/core-nodes/n8n-nodes-base.executeworkflow.md. No new workflow DSL, scheduler or service.
title: Ship tested understand-review-CI workflow recipes
